Proximus Global, combining the strengths of Telesign, BICS, and Route Mobile, is transforming the future of communications and digital identity. Together, our solutions fuel innovation across the world’s largest companies and emerging brands. Our unrivaled global reach empowers businesses to create engaging experiences with built-in fraud protection across the entire customer lifecycle.

Our comprehensive suite of solutions – from our super network for voice, messaging, and data, to 5G and IoT; and from verification and intelligence to CPaaS for personalized omnichannel engagement – enables businesses and communities to thrive. Reaching over 5 billion subscribers, securing more than 180 billion transactions annually, and connecting 1,000+ destinations, we honor our commitment to connect, protect and engage everyone, everywhere.

Key highlights include:

• Powering over 13 billion digital communications each month
• Supporting 3,500+ active customers — including enterprises, OTTs, and mobile operators — through a presence in 50+ global offices across 100+ countries
• Managing 50% of the world’s roaming data traffic and connecting 150 million IoT devices
• Driving innovation in 5G, private networks, and IoT enablement, positioning Proximus Global as a leader in next-generation communication technologies
• Committed to a unified vision, Proximus Global is unlocking new opportunities and enabling seamless global communications for businesses worldwide
Please note that this position is based in Brussels and offered as a permanent contract (CDI). It is not a freelance opportunity. The role requires on-site presence 2 to 3 days per week.

Job Title: Business Analyst - IT (Voice & Cloud Communication) 
Location: Brussels, Belgium 
Department: Application and Solution Development 

Role Overview 
 

As a Business Analyst IT, you will play a pivotal role in bridging business needs with technical solutions. You will be responsible for gathering and analyzing requirements, designing solutions, and supporting Agile development teams to deliver high-impact functionalities for BICS Voice and Cloud Communication services as part of Proximus Global. 
 

Key Responsibilities 

• Building and maintaining a strong and trustful relationship with our stakeholders via solid communication and close collaboration. 
• Engage with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and problem definitions, translating them into system requirements. 
• Prioritize and maintain the product backlog with the support of the Product Owner in a continuous collaborative mode. 
• Conduct meetings and closely collaborate with business community, end-users, platform owners, engineers, architects, developers, QA teams, process manager and external partners to shape and deliver effective business solutions. 
• Determine the detailed specifications required to develop and improve the business applications.  
• Achieve consensus by reconciling business needs, technical/security/legal constraints and architecture principles. 
• Ensure accurate and evolving effort estimations from project inception through detailed design and backlog management, enabling realistic planning and resource allocation. 
• Producing and maintaining comprehensive solution documentation artefacts (user stories, functiona

Your Profile 

• Solid IT background with minimum 3-5 years as business/functional analyst.  
• Strong analytical abilities with problem-solving and results-oriented mindset. 
• Proven practice of Scrum development methodologies, ceremonies and related tools. 
• Familiar with requirements gathering and development cost estimation techniques. 
• Ability to lead meetings, achieve compromises and articulate complex solutions to both business and technical audiences. 
• Aptitude to challenge status-quo and be innovative in solution definition. 
• Fluent in English with excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills.  
• Self-driven and autonomous, consistently applying an agile and value-driven approach to software development. 
• Learning and adapting quickly to new domain knowledge and technologies. 
 
Preferred Qualifications 

• Knowledge about cloud communication and voice carrier related services and technologies. Familiarity with BSS/OSS systems and service orchestration. 
• Experience in an international business environment and with distributed teams. 
• Practice of data modeling, data mining techniques and tooling (SQL, ERD,…). 
• Experience in designing application interfaces and API’s contracts.

A job at Proximus? You’ll find that everything revolves around the idea ‘Think Possible’. This means: we always assume that something is possible, even if it seems impossible. Well, especially so, actually. Call it a way of thinking that involves being open to a world of digital solutions that make our lives easier. And our way of working smarter.

About the Role

As a CI/CD Engineer, you will contribute to the implementation and evolution of our DevOps ecosystem, supporting CI/CD tooling and promoting DevOps best practices across the organization. You’ll play a key role in enabling efficient, secure, and scalable software delivery pipelines, with a focus on GitHub, Jenkins, and related technologies.

Key Responsibilities

• Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines, primarily using GitHub, GitHub Runners
• Monitor CI/CD tool performance and usage to ensure reliability, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to embed CI/CD principles and define best practices for secure, automated software delivery
• Provide support for Azure cloudification initiatives and ensure integration with CI/CD pipelines.
• Conduct training sessions and workshops to upskill development teams on CI/CD practices.
• Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously enhance the CI/CD ecosystem.
• Work closely with development and operations teams to ensure alignment and collaboration.
Work Environment

• Agile, hands-on technical role within a dynamic engineering environment.
• Opportunity to shape and evolve CI/CD practices across the organization.
• Collaboration with a diverse team of engineers, developers, and IT professionals.
 

Your profile

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in CI/CD pipeline management and DevSecOps practices.
• Solid knowledge of Agile and Scrum frameworks, with practical experience working in Scrum teams (ceremonies, roles, and continuous improvement mindset).
• Strong interest in the evolution of Artificial Intelligence, particularly AI‑powered coding assistance tools (such as GitHub Copilot), and a willingness to explore their responsible use to improve developer productivity and code quality
• Strong experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions/Runners and related tools.
• Familiarity with SonarQube and Aikido is a strong plus.
• Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
• Proficiency in scripting and automation tools: PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, etc.
• Experience with build tools and package managers: Maven, Node.js, npm, Nexus, JFrog.
• Good understanding of deploying various platforms: web apps, microservices, serverless, etc.
• Familiarity with standard databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) is a plus.
• Experience with Azure and related cloud services is a plus.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• 
Fluent in English (spoken and written).

• Oversee and follow up on key security capability initiatives, such technical implementation projects and operational process definition & roll-out (for example, SIEM, SOC, backup/restore, DR/BCP).
• Contribute to audit readiness and certification processes.
 

Your profile

Experience

Required expertise and skills

• Clear communicator (technical and executive audiences).

•

A People Manager within our Java community is a key figure who develops talent, guides employees, and strengthens the connection between people and the broader Sopra Steria strategy. You combine technical affinity with Java development and a strong passion for coaching, growth, and people development.

• Your primary focus is on individual coaching and development, helping each consultant grow, perform, and find their place within the organization.

• You build strong, trust-based relationships with your people and ensure they feel heard, supported, and challenged.
• You encourage them to grow, provide direction for their career path, and foster a healthy, motivating work environment.
• You focus on long-term development and sustainable growth, rather than short-term operational priorities.
What you will do

• Act as a coach first: you listen, challenge, and support individuals in becoming the best version of themselves.
• Evaluate performance based on project outcomes and present these evaluations in HR committees, where you also share insights on potential and career progression.
• Ensure fair, qualitative, and continuous performance follow-up, with a strong focus on development rather than evaluation alone.
• Support employees in defining and shaping their career path within Sopra Steria.
• Help individuals discover their strengths, ambitions, and growth opportunities, and translate these into concrete development actions.
• Create a culture of trust, psychological safety, and open communication.
• Foster an environment where people feel safe to speak up, learn, and grow.
• Act as a mentor and sparring partner for consultants, supporting them with professional challenges or personal development questions.
• Be a trusted advisor in key moments: feedback, doubts, growth decisions, or challenges on projects.
• Contribute to the Java community by stimulating knowledge sharing and connecting people.
• Encourage collaboration and learning, without owning delivery or operational outcomes
• Translate Sopra Steria’s strategic objectives into meaningful context for your people.
• Help employees understand how they can grow within the broader organization and what opportunities lie ahead.
Impact of the role

• As a People Manager Java, you are a catalyst for individual growth and engagement.
• You make a direct impact on people’s careers, motivation, and sense of belonging.
• You ensure that talent feels supported, can develop, and remains engaged with Sopra Steria.
• Your success is reflected in strong relationships, personal growth, and long-term retention.
• You create an environment where consultants can thrive and continuously improve.
• You help build confident, autonomous professionals who contribute to the organization in their own way.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, you will:

• Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
• Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
• Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
• Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
• Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers.  In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
• Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.

The Architecture Department at BNP Paribas Fortis is the strategic backbone of our digital transformation.

You will ensure alignment with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and business needs.

You will help clarify complex IAM concepts (e.g., federation, attribute-based access control, identity lifecycle management) and ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and user-friendly.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Risk and Compliance Awareness: Strong understanding of IT security and cybersecurity risks (e.g., identity threats, credential abuse) and how to mitigate them through architectural controls, auditing, and least-privilege access models.

• You express yourself fluently in English, both orally and in writing, and have a basic knowledge of Dutch or French
